title.en: The Morning of Our Promise Is Still Distant

comments.text: Just barely made it home~ Today is Episode 5 of the anime. This anime is finally getting a bath episode too. Look forward to it!
Personally, pay attention to Emilia-tan's outfit in episode 5. I think nighttime Emilia-tan is the cutest.
It's starting!
First save point updated.
Unison.
In that instant, our hearts become one.
It starts like this, but the sponsor card is so calculatedly cute.
The Redo commercial is seriously cool, isn't it...
Before we knew it, the OP release date is only ten days away too!
A part starts!
Loli appears.
Encounter Beatrice -> save point -> we are here now.
Apparently some people can do this finger twirl and some people can't. I don't really remember why.
Beatrice is a tranquilizer for the soul.
Beatrice's kindness in connecting "Door Crossing" to the garden.
Emilia-tan's way of running is cute.
That little spin here is cute.
Cat appears.
"What's tan? Where did it come from?"
Second loop, now it's the morning dining hall. The conversation is roughly the same as the first loop.
The long-awaited bath.
The courage not to hide it.
Just what kind of splashing sound is that supposed to be...
This is the author's crowning bath scene.
If you look closely, Roswaal's makeup is properly washed off here. A bath-only privilege.
Hide your pitiful little thing.
This is the first full panty shot here.
Roswaal is naked, and then Roswaal's underwear appears. What were the people making this anime thinking...?
Teacher Ram's kind (not really) late-night private lesson.
Damn! They'll find out it was the author who picked Roswaal's underwear!!
"...Hmph!" A part ends!
A contest of mutual embarrassment unfolding between the author and staff member Hirano-san.
B part starts!
"I'll take your measurements for yaaa!"
Ram and Rem's maid outfits include regular wear, going-out wear, morning wear, night wear, and many more.

But the setting that they never wear anything except maid outfits is one of the few parts where the author felt turning it into anime was a mistake! Especially when you see Emilia-tan changing clothes.
The difference in the sisters' abilities shown by the garden trees.
Some might say it's questionable that big sister is satisfied with that quality of work, but she's just spoiling herself because she knows Rem will fix it.
I like how Puck goes at the sweets here with his whole body.
"Will you help me?" Rem works five times harder than you do! You should be helping her!
Subaru-kun's all-out joke bombing spectacularly.
This is a precious barefoot Rem scene. Let this satisfy you for today.
Petra's first appearance!
The two whose fashion sense is obviously on a higher level are the regulars.

Subaru-kun's all-out joke bombing spectacularly. 
Rem's voice here is wonderful, isn't it.
Rem's smile here is demonically good, isn't it.
Nighttime Emilia-tan.
A mortifyingly defenseless Akujo.
Isn't Emilia-tan's nightgown here ridiculously cute?
Where is Subaru's voice even coming from right now?
"It'd be embarrassing if my friends saw me."
This is one of the author's fixations, but Emilia-tan says "deito," not "date."
Here she is, Emilia-tan at her absolute cutest.
Part B is over! And the ED debuts for the first time!
As for the ending, at the time of episode 2 it could have spoiled what was coming next, so they gave it a special form. This time, we finally got the true ED.
Part C begins...
Fate VS Subaru, one-match showdown.
A realistic vomit scene.
Realizing that something has happened, Subaru-kun is heading for his heroine.
Episode 5 is over.――
Part C felt like it was from a completely different anime. Still, that 30 minutes went by fast. And now, healing is provided.

As for episode 5, because of how episode 4 played out, it was restructured so that events from the previous loop that couldn't be picked up from the original were moved here and the like. Thanks to that, I think episodes 4 and 5 together ended up with a much better flow and hook.

Well, this time I think it's enough if you just remember that Beatrice, Emilia-tan, and Rem were cute in Parts A and B, that Nee-sama's sleeping face was cute, and that Roswaal was dangling around. Let's forget about Part C.
The first ED with actual animation! Emilia-tan looks adorable in her sleepwear! Rem's smile is a million volts! Roswaal dangling around! If you're rewatching, keep an eye on those parts!
Well then, thanks for joining me again this week! Please tune in again next week too! G'night!

Oh, and one last thing:
○Fate VS Subaru● (utter defeat)
